title: A good average can hide a bad answer.

scenes.text: Would you ship an answer that scores well overall, but fails a required grounding check?
scenes.detail: Make the failure visible before release.

scenes.text: My evaluator separates weighted rubric scores from hard thresholds.
scenes.detail: JSON/YAML criteria · normalized weights · explicit gates

scenes.text: Fourteen deterministic metrics run offline. Optional LLM judges score custom criteria.
scenes.detail: Heuristics and judges both have limitations.

title: An answer needs a path back to evidence.

scenes.text: The problem: quality guidelines are often prose, while releases need repeatable decisions.
scenes.detail: Turn the guideline into an inspectable evaluation contract.

scenes.text: Each case carries an input, an output and the reference or context needed to judge it.
scenes.detail: The repository includes an 18-case RAG-QA benchmark.

scenes.text: JSON and YAML rubrics define criteria, weights and optional hard thresholds.
scenes.detail: A hard gate can fail a case even when its weighted score is high.

scenes.text: Deterministic metrics check overlap, exact matches, numbers, structure and other constraints.
scenes.detail: 14 built-in metrics · no API key required for core evaluation

scenes.text: An optional model judge uses a vendor-neutral chat interface for custom criteria.
scenes.detail: Judge scores still need calibration and human review.

scenes.text: The engine produces per-case breakdowns, JSON reports and an interactive HTML dashboard.
scenes.detail: CLI fail-under gates connect the evaluation to CI.

scenes.text: Token overlap is not semantic truth. A passing benchmark does not prove broad reliability.
scenes.detail: Inspect failure cases and expand the test set before trusting a new use case.

scenes.text: The repository shows the scoring code, tests and benchmark. Explore it from my portfolio.

scenes.text: Start with the question: how do we answer from a document collection without inventing missing information?
scenes.detail: Walkthrough of the offline default path, not a live customer deployment.

scenes.text: The application connects a FastAPI backend with a browser chat interface.
scenes.detail: Separate services and interfaces keep each stage inspectable.

scenes.text: Ingestion splits documents into sentence-aware chunks instead of arbitrary character slices.
scenes.detail: Chunk boundaries affect what evidence retrieval can recover.

scenes.text: The default feature-hashing embedder works without downloading a model.
scenes.detail: Reproducible offline development · configurable embeddings

scenes.text: A cosine vector store finds candidates. Re-ranking blends similarity with keyword overlap.
scenes.detail: Retrieval quality determines which evidence reaches the reader.

scenes.text: The extractive reader answers from retrieved context and abstains when the context is insufficient.
scenes.detail: The default is extractive, not unrestricted generative completion.

scenes.text: Source citations connect the answer to its originating chunk.
scenes.detail: A citation is useful only if the passage supports the claim.

scenes.text: A router sends arithmetic questions to a restricted AST calculator and other questions to RAG.
scenes.detail: Tool routing is explicit and returned to the interface.

scenes.text: Server-Sent Events stream responses through the chat endpoint.
scenes.detail: Streaming changes delivery; it does not itself improve factual quality.

scenes.text: The evaluation harness checks retrieval hit-rate, reciprocal rank, faithfulness and answer relevance.
scenes.detail: Sample-corpus thresholds are gated in CI.

scenes.text: Configuration can swap in sentence-transformers, pgvector, Ollama, Gemini or OpenAI backends.
scenes.detail: Optional integrations require their own runtime setup and evaluation.

scenes.text: The limitation: sample-corpus checks do not establish reliability across arbitrary documents.
scenes.detail: Broader corpora, adversarial missing-evidence cases and abstention tests come next.

scenes.text: Explore the backend, tests and evaluation code. The best evidence is the implementation itself.
